query.description: Seconds to long-poll for a terminal state (0-60). Defaults to 0 (return immediately).

variable.description: (Required) The job id returned by a generation call (its `id` in the 202 response).

request.description: Fetch one job you started through the API or MCP. Statuses: queued, running (both non-terminal - the response carries poll_after_ms, wait at least that long before asking again), then succeeded (read `result`), failed (read `error`: {code, subcode, message, retriable}; the held credits are refunded) or canceled. Generations typically finish within a few minutes; a job still queued after 15 minutes can be cancelled and resubmitted. Better still, pass wait= (up to 60) to long-poll: the request is held until the job reaches a terminal state, so one call replaces a polling loop. Once status is succeeded, `result` holds exactly what the synchronous form of the operation named by task_type would have returned. This is a free read-only lookup (no credits). Requires an API key (user scope).
